title: Absolute Sword Sense
blurb: For as long as he can remember, Woonhwi So has been the black sheep of his family and clan. Because his spirit core has been destroyed, he has no choice but to serve as a third-rate spy for the Blood Cult. One day, during his mission to find the legendary Blade Scroll, he is killed and sent 10 years into the past. When Woonhwi regains consciousness, he realizes that he has been sent back to the day he was kidnapped by the Blood Cult, and that he has gained a mysterious ability to hear the voice of a dagger.

title: Absolute Regression
blurb: The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him–even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

title: The Academy's Genius Swordsman
blurb: Following a momentous battle against giants for the fate of the world, Ronan emerges victorious as the last man standing of the imperial army. As he laments this hollow victory with his dying commander, Grand Marshal Adeshan, they quickly learn that the war is far from over and an overwhelming force of giants descends from the heavens. Fearing the worst, yet seeing hope in the courageous Ronan, Adeshan uses her last time slip to send him back to the past, so that he can enroll in the prestigious Phileon Academy and become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen!

title: A Wimp’s Tower Strategy Guide
blurb: Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Ju-Hyeok Bong calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed “wimp,” perfectly content with staying under the radar… That is, until he is named as a player. Will he risk everything by entering the tower, or keep running from the one chance that could change his life?

title: Reincarnation of the Fist King
blurb: Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

title: The Martial Genius Who Remembers Everything
blurb: So-un Jin, a third-rate martial artist with an exceptional memory, awakens 30 years in the past, just before the return of the Demonic Cult. He's been given a second chance, but that's where divine intervention ends. With no innate talent for martial arts, no legendary master to guide him, and only a small, powerless sect to call home, his future seems just as bleak as before. Can So-un use his knowledge of the future to change the course of fate?

title: Overgeared
blurb: Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

title: Prologue-eseo 30-nyeoni Heulleotda
blurb: I "transmigrated" into a world I'd never seen before. For thirty years, I believed I was living in a classic fantasy RPG. I became a war hero, retired, and thought I was finally about to see the ending. But... Those thirty years were only the prologue. It turns out the real story is about an academy?

title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2
blurb: Earth lost the fight for survival in the BattleNet system and humanity now faces eradication. However, Jihan Seong is given another chance. He has returned three years into the past before BattleNet became a life-or-death game. With his knowledge of the future, he’s determined to become the strongest player. Will Jihan be able to change the fate of humanity? And more importantly, can he protect the ones he loves from those who want him to fail?

title: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back!
blurb: Struck by an enemy’s arrow, the powerless Prince Davey O’Rowane falls into a coma. His soul travels to a place where the greatest of the great gather—the honorable Hall of Heroes. There a thousand years pass as Davey undergoes excruciating training under their watchful eyes to become a hero too strong for his own good. Now back to his timeline and his kingdom, he’s wide awake and the enemies hiding in the king’s court better be prepared. The prince they had dismissed is now their biggest threat!

title: There's No Such Thing as a Bad Lady
blurb: Raised in the slums of Ebelstein, Derek knows all too well that magic cannot bridge social divides. Through harsh lessons and hard-earned discipline, he rises to become a second-tier mage, scraping by as a mercenary. Life takes a different turn when he is appointed as a magical tutor to Diella Duplain-- the temperamental youngest daughter of a noble house, unable to wield magic despite her lineage. Though Derek is her last resort before exile to a convent, Diella clashes with him from the start. Together, will they be able to prove that there’s no such thing as a “bad” lady?

title: The Warrior's Ballad
blurb: Only the purest of souls may shine as a star, the brightest of which is inevitably the most destructive of them all. The demon and the hero are but two sides of the same blade. A hundred years after his death, the fallen swordmaster of the empire returns as young Ricardt and sets out on a journey to uncover the truth behind the war that consumed his first life.

title: Academy Pyeonuijeomeuro Healing-halgeyo
blurb:
Lee Young-Jin. Twenty-nine years old. Orphan. Convenience Store Master. He came to Seoul with just five million won and, after his business acumen was recognized at a convenience store in Seongbuk-dong, on the very night he was set to become the store’s owner…
He was struck by a damn delivery truck and met his untimely end… but he finds himself possessed by the body of the villainous prince from the crappy game he used to be obsessed with. I. Wolfram von Lohengrin. Prince. Ousted student council president.
An intro-scene villain who gets his head chopped off… but I refuse to die again the moment I die! Love and adventure are the protagonists’ domain anyway. From now on, my dream is to be the owner of a convenience store in this other world. As a convenience store master wielding amazing skills worthy of a true “rotten scum” character, I’ll clean out the pockets of everyone at the academy!

title: Shadow of the Supreme
blurb: Yang-Cheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world’s most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn’t end with the same regrets?

title: The Sword-Eating Swordmaster
blurb: Only a swordmaster can slay another. Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him. In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within. With each sword consumed, Arhan draws one step closer to vengeance. To avenge his loved ones and restore House Karavan to its former glory, he must survive the perilous path to becoming a swordmaster.

title: The Reborn Young Lord is an Assassin
blurb: Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the Duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!

title: Pick Me Up
blurb: 1-Star heroes are just fodder for learning a boss' attack patterns. That was Seojin Han's philosophy when playing the notoriously difficult game Pick Me Up. But after being transported into the game as one of those 1-star heroes, he's got no choice but to rise in rank and defeat the player controlling him and his party. Can a gacha game character hope to defeat a player akin to being his god?

title: The Reincarnated King of Fists
blurb: In a world where humans enslave non-human species, the powerful wizard Leppenhardt creates an empire to safeguard these beings. However, his reign ends when he's defeated by the brutally strong Tesron, the "King of Fists." But death isn’t the end, because Leppenhardt awakens in Tesron's young body! Now armed with incredible strength and a new identity, he sets off to free the non-human races again. Can the new King of Fists reshape the world for all, or will his second chance slip away?

title: Chronicles of a Doomed Prodigy
blurb: Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny.

title: The Swordmaster's Son
blurb: Jin Runcandel was destined to become the head of his swordmaster clan. But despite his best efforts, he's banished for his shoddy swordsmanship. Though Jin eventually makes a contract with the god Solderet and is freed from the curse that hindered his abilities, he meets a rather unfortunate end. In the next moment, however, he awakens as a baby, long before his tragedy began. Armed with a second chance and some new powers, Jin swears to fulfill his destiny and become the ultimate swordmaster.

title: Space Cheon-ma 3077
blurb: Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change…

title: Nano Machine
blurb: Nanotechnology meets martial arts at the Mashin Academy. Yeo-Un’s mother may not be one of the High Priest’s six official wives, but his father’s blood still qualifies him for a chance at the position of Minor Priest. Will a mysterious nanomachine injection from a future descendent help Yeo-un in this fierce competition against his powerful half-siblings?

title: Yasaengeseo Gallery-reul Eodeotda
blurb:
I woke up from a drunken stupor to find myself in a strange forest that felt completely unreal.

[Welcome to the Continental Unified Community!]

With no idea what was going on, Jong-Hyeok, stranded in the forest, saw a gallery he’d only ever seen online appear as a hologram right before his eyes. From the Heavenly Horse of the Central Plains to the Empire’s Swordmaster, this gallery brings together the continent’s most powerful figures. In this place, where he must survive solely on the items and information they send him,
it’s said to be the wilds known as the “Forest of the Four Seasons”—a place from which no one has ever returned alive once they’ve entered...

title: Mumu Mujeok
blurb: Mumu, a boy raised in the mountains with monstrous strength, enters the prestigious Martial Arts Academy. He knows nothing of martial arts, politics, or the deadly schemes of the noble clans. But when you can crush boulders with your bare hands, how much does technique really matter?

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter
blurb: In the mysterious, RPG dungeon-like Tower, Confucius Kim lives a mundane existence, envying all the star hunters. One day, his wish for more is granted with a legendary skill to copy others’ abilities… at the cost of his life. Before he can make sense of it, he’s killed by the #1 hunter, the Flame Emperor! But this activates his skill and now he’s copied a new one, the ability to travel back in time upon death. How will Confucius use these skills to outplay the competition and rise to the top?

title: The Extra’s Academy Survival Guide
blurb: Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

title: Best Teacher Baek
blurb: Once the finest instructor in the Blood Cult, Suryong Baek is killed, only to wake up in the body of someone who teaches martial arts at a small rural academy. His new body may be weak, but he knows how to fix it, and it’s not the first time that he’s found himself in a body that can’t access its inner power. Curing his body requires money, however, and Suryong decides that becoming the greatest instructor at a top academy is the best way to do it. Since he’ll be up against tough competition, Suryong will have to use everything he’s got to become a teaching superstar.

title: Reborn as a Hatchling
blurb: After 999 years of painful endurance, Imugi can't wait to finally become a dragon. But after his death with just one year until ascension, he wakes up to find himself reborn as a hatchling with stubby little legs and a squishable cheek to boot! Having never known kindness, he sets out into a world filled with magic and dragons, and with the love and help from those around him, gradually opens the door to his heart. To become a dragon, he will have to take baby steps... and make friends along the way.

title: I’m the Max-Level Newbie
blurb: Kang Jin-Hyeok, a gaming streamer, and content creator is the only person who has cleared the game, [Tower of Trials]. However, as the game’s popularity declines, it becomes increasingly difficult for him to continue making a living as a content creator. Jinhyeok prepares to end his 11-year-long relationship with the game and say goodbye to his humble group of subscribers. But on that very day, the Tower of Trials appears in reality with a message saying that humanity will perish unless all players clear each floor within 90 days. Jin-Hyeok, who knows the game better than anyone, decides to use his knowledge to his advantage and dominate the tower. It’s time to show everyone what a hardcore gamer can do!

title: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord
blurb: Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn’t quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?!

title: Serim's Golden Rule
blurb: Everyone's terrified of Se-Rim Han. Word is, she's a gangster. So of course Seung-U Kang, the ultimate golden boy, ends up with her in the school’s mentor-mentee program. He decides the only way forward is to become her friend, but the closer he gets, the less anything makes sense about her. What starts as a simple assignment soon turns into something neither of them planned, a dangerous romance between a girl who lives like there's no tomorrow and a boy whose entire life has been meticulously mapped out.

title: Miraereul Boneun Tujaja
blurb: Kang Jin-hoo gains an extraordinary ability to foresee the future after a life-changing accident during his military service. Armed with this unique power, he dives into the world of investments, targeting companies and financial markets to amass wealth and become the world’s top investor. But his vision extends beyond just making money. Kang Jin-hoo’s foresight begins to influence the global economy, political systems, major corporations, and even the course of globalization itself. Now, with his sights set on reshaping the world of finance and beyond, he is about to rewrite the rules of the future.

title: Space Marine-ege Sangtaechangi Saenggim
blurb:
In 2126, humanity has entered an era where it has created Gates, ventured into space, and fights monsters.

[The Status Window has been activated.]

Space Marine Kim Seo-jun, on the first day of his reenlistment, has gained a “Status Window.”

title: The Sichuan Tang Clan’s Entomologist
blurb:
Fabre, a famous million-viewer streamer known for his daring encounters with venomous creatures, is bitten by a black mamba while filming in Africa and wakes up in the mystical world of Murim. To his surprise, the jungles of Murim offer him a peaceful farming life in which he enjoys cultivating various poisonous species. But his tranquility is short-lived when he crosses paths with members of the Tang Clan, the masters of poison and devious tactics.
"I see potential in you. Become a part of our family."

title: The White Tower’s Rogue Mage
blurb: Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

title: The Patron of Villains
blurb: One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!

title: Neungnyeok Meokgo Level Up-neun Yeongjunim
blurb:
The continent lay in ruins at the hands of the Emperor. Even the allied forces, the last hope of all, had suffered a crushing defeat. It was a moment of utter despair.
“Ad. This is an order. Absorb my heart.”
"Predation," the ability to devour another person’s talents and powers whole. Adrian absorbs the heart of Ian, his dying hero and friend, and regresses fifteen years into the past, back to when he was nothing more than a good-for-nothing scoundrel.
“Ian… You want me to save the world? Sorry, but I can't care less about that..."
His brutal combat experience from his past life, a Player System seemingly inherited from Ian, and "Predation," an ability that allows him to grow stronger without limit, all come together... and Adrian begins to grow at an overwhelming pace.
“...But I will make you one promise. I’ll hunt those bastards down to the very end… and chew their hearts into pieces!!”

title: Bukbu Daegongui Michin Derilsawi
blurb:
Galahad, an elite wizard and top agent of the Intelligence Bureau, was sold off as the Grand Duke of the North's son-in-law for political reasons. Meanwhile, the ice-cold daughter of the duke is the "key" to defeating the Demon King and saving the world. Determined to win her heart, Galahad approached her with his usual madness and an utterly ridiculous level of determination. However, his target is a Swordmaster who burns mana, and even the slightest touch from a mage causes him to endure excruciating pain that courses through his entire body...
"I want to touch her again. This time, just for a bit longer—"

title: Log-in Murim
blurb: When an interdimensional portal appeared and released countless monsters across the world, humanity didn’t take the threat lying down. Mankind fought back, defeating the monsters' Demon King and creating a new way of life as "hunters." But when Taekyung Jin, a struggling, low-ranked hunter, accidentally logs into a game on a beat-up VR console, he finds himself trapped in an all-new world, unable to log out.

title: Surviving the Game as a Barbarian
blurb: After spending nine years on Dungeon and Stone, the role-playing game that no player has ever beaten, Han-Su Lee finally reaches the dungeon of the final boss. As soon as he opens the gate, however, he suddenly sees a message that says his tutorial has been completed and finds himself in the body of Bjorn Yandel, a real barbarian within the game. An exciting adventure awaits him as he endeavors to abide by the laws of the fictional world!

title: Dongsaengi Cheonjaeyeotda
blurb:
Yun Ha-Jun, who struggled to pursue his musical career despite his iffy talents and ended up sacrificing his own family along the way.
"If only I could turn back time...! "
One day, after living with regrets and alcohol for a while, he woke up and found himself had returned to the past. Just then, it dawned on him.The fact that my younger sister is a musical genius...! Now is the time to turn my life around, by producing my younger sister into becoming the best singer!

title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
blurb: In the game Aether World, Baek Yuseol is considered the most useless character because he can't use magic like everyone else. His only skill, Blink, is a short-range teleportation ability most players consider worthless. But when he’s tasked with reaching the game's true ending, Baek Yuseol decides to use his unconventional skill to achieve this impossible goal. Can this so-called "trash" character outsmart his powerful peers, form unlikely alliances, and ultimately master the game?

title: Night Shift in Another World
blurb: Chan Lee thought his life hit rock bottom when he lost his office job. Then he started working at a convenience store connected to another world. With customers ranging from dog men to goblins and dragon girls, every shift brings new chaos. Between supernatural mishaps and late-night shifts, Chan soon builds an unlikely community of loyal regulars.

title: I Shall Master this Family!
blurb: The great Lombardi family was once at the top of the empire. After the death of its patriarch, the fate of the family and that of Firentia, born from a Lombardi and a peasant, fall to ruin at the hands of her useless and cruel cousins. But when she’s reincarnated as her seven-year-old self, she’ll work to protect the family’s honor, gain her grandpa Lulac’s favor, and prevent her own father’s death. In this lifetime, there’s only one way for her to win: become the head of their mighty household.

title: Dungeon Odyssey
blurb: When the war between the aboveground and underground ended, humanity was joined by so-called "dungeon babies," those gifted with supernatural abilities and an obsession with the labyrinths below ground. Despite being a dungeon baby, Kim Jin-U suppressed his instincts, choosing to live an ordinary life as a guide and caring for his family. But when an expedition goes wrong and he somehow ends up becoming the new owner of a labyrinth, he discovers that he cannot ignore his instincts forever...

title: A Flame Reborn
blurb: Logan MacLine, a middle-aged knight fighting for the independence army, is intent on getting revenge against the empire which took over the kingdom and executed his brother when he ends up dying in battle. But when he wakes, he is a young man again, and has yet to be disowned for his terrible behavior. Using his experience and knowledge from his past life, Logan recruits a few talented individuals to develop new weapons, build an army, and make enough money to fund it all. But will he be able to make amends with his family and stop the empire's march?

title: The Crown I'll Claim
blurb: "I wanted him so badly that I would have given up everything for him... And in the end, I did." After losing her crown, her children, and her life to the man she loved, Princess Medea finds herself back in her 17-year-old body. Now aware of the treacherous alliance between her ex-lover and her uncle, who have been scheming for the throne and fueling a rebellion, she's determined to save her kingdom and seize the reins of her future. Can the princess escape a tragic death and reclaim her destiny?

title: The Bastard of Swordborne
blurb: Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift—a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the “Ragnar Defect,” he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. But death was only the beginning. Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

title: The Dragon Slayer's Regression on Another Level
blurb: Zeke Draker was the first of House Draker to fail his Awakening. And for that, he was cast out. Forced to survive in a brutal world, Zeke rose from disgrace and earned the name Phantom of the North. On a mission to stop the emperor from obtaining an ancient relic, Zeke was hunted and killed by imperial forces. But fate had other plans. Zeke awakens as a 12-year-old boy back in the Cradle, House Draker’s elite training ground. Given a second chance, Zeke’s determined to rewrite his fate.

title: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
blurb: Who was that guy that once said, “An army marches on its stomach”? When hapless agricultural science student Jangcheol Kim starts playing the fantasy MMORPG “Paladins of Blood” to escape the stress of school life, he never imagined he would end up inside the game, much less as its final boss. How can a ruthless demon overlord win over his subjects? Perhaps with potatoes.
